description: The file defines the SugarChart class, which provides functionality for generating, processing, and exporting chart data and XML configurations within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for data retrieval, XML generation, chart configuration, and rendering, indicating it is a core component for chart visualization.

classes.name: SugarChart
classes.description: A class responsible for generating, configuring, and rendering chart visualizations within the SuiteCRM platform, including XML data generation, currency handling, and resource management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SugarChart instance, setting up database connection, Smarty template engine, chart properties, currency settings, and export type based on server capabilities.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Executes a database query and populates the data_set array with the resulting rows.

methods.name: constructBaseURL
methods.description: Builds the base URL string from the base_url array.

methods.name: constructURL
methods.description: Constructs a complete URL including base URL parameters and additional URL parameters.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the internal data_set array to the provided dataset.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Configures chart properties such as title, subtitle, type, legend, labels, and thousands separator.

methods.name: setDisplayProperty
methods.description: Sets specific display property in chart properties array.

methods.name: setColors
methods.description: Assigns a list of colors for the chart.

methods.name: xmlHeader
methods.description: Returns the XML header string for the chart XML.

methods.name: xmlFooter
methods.description: Returns the XML footer string for the chart XML.

methods.name: xmlProperties
methods.description: Outputs the XML properties section based on chart properties and colors.

methods.name: xmlYAxis
methods.description: Builds XML representation of the Y-axis, including dynamic step calculation.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates total 'total' values for a specific group-by key.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Utility to generate a string with specified tabs prepended.

methods.name: tabValue
methods.description: Generates an XML node with proper indentation and htmlspecialchars encoding.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Processes data_set into grouped data for chart generation.

methods.name: processDataGroup
methods.description: Generates XML for a grouped data element with given parameters.

methods.name: calculateGroupByTotal
methods.description: Calculates total sum within a dataset group.

methods.name: calculateSingleBarMax
methods.description: Finds maximum value for a set of bar chart data points.

methods.name: checkYAxis
methods.description: Adjusts yMin and yMax in chart_yAxis based on a given value.

methods.name: convertCurrency
methods.description: Converts an amount to the user's currency based on the conversion rate.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number with specified decimal, decimal point, and thousand separator characters.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Aggregates total value across all grouped data.

methods.name: xmlDataForGroupByChart
methods.description: Generates XML data for a 'group by' chart, including subgroup details and axis checks.

methods.name: xmlDataForGaugeChart
methods.description: Generates XML data for gauge charts, including gauge phases.

methods.name: xmlDataBarChart
methods.description: Generates XML data for bar or horizontal bar charts, including drill-down links.

methods.name: xmlDataGenericChart
methods.description: Generates XML data for generic chart types, handling various grouping and drill-down logic.

methods.name: nullGroup
methods.description: Creates a null group element for missing subgroup data in chart XML.

methods.name: getXMLFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for cached XML files based on user privileges and a unique file id.

methods.name: processXmlData
methods.description: Delegates chart data processing based on chart type and returns XML data.

methods.name: xmlData
methods.description: Wraps chart XML data within a parent data tag.

methods.name: generateXML
methods.description: Constructs the full chart XML string including header, properties, data, axes, and footer.

methods.name: saveXMLFile
methods.description: Saves the XML content to a specified file, handling directory creation and encoding.

methods.name: generateChartStrings
methods.description: Creates localized chart string XML cache file.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns HTML to embed the chart in a web page, generating necessary language files if missing.

methods.name: getDashletScript
methods.description: Prepares JavaScript variables for embedding chart scripts in dashboard widgets.

methods.name: sortData
methods.description: Sorts and translates a dataset by specified key columns.
